references.context: Complete the green drop targets to reach 2x bonus.
references.label: Green target bank
references.description: The first drop-target bank needed for every Bonus X level.

references.context: Complete yellow after green to reach 3x bonus.
references.label: Yellow target bank
references.description: The second drop-target bank in the Bonus X sequence.

references.context: Complete red after yellow to reach 4x bonus.
references.label: Red target bank
references.description: The third drop-target bank in the Bonus X sequence.

references.context: Complete blue after red to reach 5x bonus.
references.label: Blue target bank
references.description: The fourth drop-target bank in the Bonus X sequence.

references.context: Collect the lit top saucer at 5x.
references.label: Collect Bonus saucer
references.description: The upper saucer that collects lit base bonus without removing Bonus X.

references.context: Use the upper mini-flippers for green and yellow targets.
references.label: Upper flippers
references.description: The two small upper flippers used for target-bank and saucer shots.

references.context: Do not rely on the center post to save a center drain.
references.label: Center post
references.description: Post between the lower flippers whose presence and return can vary by machine condition.
